_doc: Hàm Nguyệt Trang signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow catalogue-water grade 3-4. The mistress also keeps the catalogue's Moon-Well Pendant (water-moon-well-pendant, unchanged). No set.

items.name: Fist Pearl of Tuyết Lộc (Tuyết Lộc Quyền Châu)

effects.name: The Pearl Remembers (Châu Ký)
effects.rule: Each Pearl you make with the Nacre Over Grit Canon also stores one Nacre stack in the Fist Pearl; each stack fades 30 s after it is stored. When you fall below a third of your health, the Fist Pearl spends them all: you gain a ward of 4 % of maximum linh lực per stack.

items.lore: The pearl the size of a fist that a Tuyết Lộc fisher pulled from Hạo Nguyệt Hồ in 470 and sold to the manor, which began to farm pearls because of it (A007). Seven hundred years of mistresses have laid their own nacre over it, and it is now the size of a child's head and as heavy as a stone seal. Kiều Nguyệt Châu throws it like one.
items.build_use: The mistress's weapon: Water damage and a last ward when the long fight turns against her.
items.made_by: the lake (A007); re-nacred by each mistress

items.name: Moon-Fish Lantern (Nguyệt Ngư Đăng)

effects.name: False Moon (Giả Nguyệt)
effects.rule: While the lantern is lit, your Moon in the Water reflection lasts twice as long, and allies standing within it regenerate linh lực as if they were cultivating.

items.lore: A lantern of oyster shell ground thin as paper, hung over the pool on moonless nights so the spirit fish think the moon is still on the water. It was made after the freeze of 748, when the fish lived through a winter on the moon's reflection alone (C146) and the manor learned they would die without it. Mục Tiềm Uyên has lit it every dark night for a hundred and fifty years.
items.build_use: The pool-keeper's sustain: healing and linh lực for a fight he means to outlast.

items.name: Nacre Robe of Trầm Bích (Trầm Bích Trân Bào)
items.lore: A robe of lake silk sewn with a thousand flakes of nacre from the oyster beds, worn by each mistress at the moon rite on the stilt-halls. In moonlight it is hard to tell from the pool.
items.build_use: Linh lực and a cheaper ward: she lets the other side spend first.

items.name: Frost-Lotus Pin of Kiều Băng Liên (Băng Liên Trâm)
items.lore: The hairpin her grandmother wore the winter of 748, when she sat on the frozen pool and kept the spirit fish alive. Frost forms on it in summer.
items.build_use: The thread of Ice in her root, made to last.

sets.name: Moon over Pearl (Nguyệt Châu Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: What Hurts You, Wrap (Bao Thương): each foe art your ward absorbs also lays one Nacre on the Fist Pearl; when the Fist Pearl spends its Nacre, your ward freezes for 2 s and cannot be broken, and the pearl you cast next carries 2 Ice stacks.

sets.story: The pearl of 470, the mistresses' robe and the grandmother's pin. Kiều Nguyệt Châu holds all three; the Moon-Well Pendant stays in her keeping, unworn. She means the pin for her grand-niece, which would split the set.
